timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I'm Sonya Vesandani and I am the founder and CEO of Sunshine Teaches Training.
At Sunshine Teaches Training, we offer the diploma in Montessori education for parents and early childhood educators.
You can learn online with us from the comfort of your own homes.
When you enroll to do our Montessori diploma online, you will have access to over 200 video presentations that you can play and replay.
You can learn at your own pace and you can also implement Montessori as you learn.
With us, you will learn Montessori step by step and the right way.
You will be able to implement Montessori with the confidence of being fully certified.
We aim at student success so you will have your very own success body to support you throughout your learning journey.
You will learn to create materials and present them to children the right way.
Online we will be teaching you all about the principles and the philosophy of Montessori, the entire Montessori curriculum.
During the 12 day workshop, you will have hands-on experience with the materials and you will be able to see how everything then comes together.
Our graduates are already out there in the world making a difference.
The decision to take online course in Montessori diploma is the best decision I ever made in my whole life.
Our aim is to change the way parents and teachers educate children in the early years.
And so we do that one parent at a time, one teacher at a time by teaching them the Montessori way.
So if you'd like to learn more about our online Montessori diploma, feel free to contact us and we'll help you get started.
